activity.notes: Tenaya was chief of the Ahwahneechee community of Yosemite Valley. ATLAS corrects the broad user label 'Miwok': the historical sources identify the specific Yosemite community as Ahwahneechee. The 1851–1853 interval represents the securely documented conflict/displacement period rather than a formal accession-to-death reign.

sources.title: National Park Service — Roosevelt, Muir, and the Grace of Place
sources.citation_text: NPS recounts the Mariposa Battalion's 1851 removal of the Ahwahneechee and identifies Tenaya as their chief.
